scenes.tts: Mice without T R P V one keep much of their response to painful heat. So what else senses the burn?
scenes.caption: Mice without TRPV1 keep much of their response to painful heat. So what else senses the burn?
scenes.visual: Title card: Three Channels, One Burn. A mouse paw near a hot surface; the TRPV1 icon is crossed out, yet the paw still lifts.
scenes.narration: Mice without TRPV1 keep much of their response to painful heat. So what else senses the burn?

scenes.tts: In twenty eleven, T R P M three was found to contribute heat sensitivity to some small mouse sensory neurons.
scenes.caption: In 2011, TRPM3 was found to contribute heat sensitivity to some small mouse sensory neurons.
scenes.visual: A cluster of small sensory neurons; a subset lights up with a TRPM3 icon. Label: 2011.
scenes.narration: In 2011, TRPM3 was found to contribute heat sensitivity to some small mouse sensory neurons.

scenes.tts: Mice lacking it avoided noxious heat less well. T R P A one was a third candidate.
scenes.caption: Mice lacking it avoided noxious heat less well. TRPA1 was a third candidate.
scenes.visual: Three channel blocks now on screen: TRPV1, TRPM3, TRPA1.
scenes.narration: Mice lacking it avoided noxious heat less well. TRPA1 was a third candidate.

scenes.tts: Suppose the three worked in series, each passing the signal to the next. What would each single knockout do?
scenes.visual: The three blocks linked in a chain into one box labelled acute withdrawal. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: Suppose the three worked in series, each passing the signal to the next. What would each single knockout do?

scenes.tts: In series, every single knockout would abolish the withdrawal. They do not.
scenes.visual: One block removed from the chain: the chain breaks, but a label reads: single knockouts do not abolish withdrawal.
scenes.narration: In series, every single knockout would abolish the withdrawal. They do not.

scenes.tts: Now suppose they work in parallel. What would it take to remove the reflex?
scenes.visual: The blocks rearrange side by side, each with its own arrow into the withdrawal box. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: Now suppose they work in parallel. What would it take to remove the reflex?

scenes.tts: All three at once. In twenty eighteen, mice lacking all three lacked acute withdrawal from noxious heat, in the reported assays.
scenes.caption: All three at once. In 2018, mice lacking all three lacked acute withdrawal from noxious heat, in the reported assays.
scenes.visual: Constructed schematic: blocks removed one at a time while the withdrawal box stays lit, labelled response retained, with no change in brightness. Then all three removed: the box goes dark. Label: acute withdrawal absent in the reported assays, 2018.
scenes.narration: All three at once. In 2018, mice lacking all three lacked acute withdrawal from noxious heat, in the reported assays.

scenes.tts: The channels are redundant for this reflex. Remove one, and the others carry the signal.
scenes.visual: Return to the parallel diagram with one block removed; the other two arrows still reach the box, which stays lit at the same brightness, labelled response retained. Label: redundant.
scenes.narration: The channels are redundant for this reflex. Remove one, and the others carry the signal.

scenes.tts: Remove all three, and the acute reflex has nothing left.
scenes.visual: All arrows gone; the withdrawal box dark.
scenes.narration: Remove all three, and the acute reflex has nothing left.

scenes.tts: But the same mice still preferred moderate temperatures.
scenes.visual: A second box, labelled preference for moderate temperatures, stays lit, fed by an arrow from a question mark.
scenes.narration: But the same mice still preferred moderate temperatures.

scenes.tts: Withdrawal and preference are different behaviours. Whatever supports preference is not exhausted by these three channels.
scenes.visual: The two boxes side by side: withdrawal, dark; preference, lit. The question-mark source glows. Label: not these three channels alone.
scenes.narration: Withdrawal and preference are different behaviours. Whatever supports preference is not exhausted by these three channels.

scenes.tts: Set this beside the cool line. The cool fibres' resting firing depends on T R P M eight.
scenes.visual: Split screen. Left: the cool line with one TRPM8 icon on its ending, linked to both cool and warm.
scenes.narration: Set this beside the cool line. The cool fibres' resting firing depends on TRPM8.
scenes.caption: Set this beside the cool line. The cool fibres' resting firing depends on TRPM8.

scenes.tts: So losing T R P M eight cost warmth. Here, three channels can each carry the heat signal.
scenes.caption: So losing TRPM8 cost warmth. Here, three channels can each carry the heat signal.
scenes.visual: Right: TRPV1, TRPM3 and TRPA1 as three parallel arrows into the withdrawal box.
scenes.narration: So losing TRPM8 cost warmth. Here, three channels can each carry the heat signal.

scenes.tts: Here, losing T R P V one alone did not abolish the burn.
scenes.caption: So losing TRPV1 alone did not abolish the burn.
scenes.visual: TRPV1 crossed out; the other two arrows still reach the withdrawal box, which stays lit at the same brightness, labelled response retained.
scenes.narration: So losing TRPV1 alone did not abolish the burn.

scenes.tts: In mice, acute heat withdrawal survives the loss of any one of three channels.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: one channel lost, the burn survives; all three lost, acute withdrawal is gone. Label: mouse.
scenes.narration: In mice, acute heat withdrawal survives the loss of any one of three channels.
